own-open-door.label: The Borg stands in an open doorway
own-open-door.explanation: A Warrior with a burned-out torch stands in an open doorway whose grid the game reports as lit, while the Borg's own map carries no glow mark for it (the state the door case exists to repair). The original scan visits only the eight neighbours, so the own-grid door case never fires and the lit mark is never repaired; the corrected scan includes the Borg's own grid, the door case fires, and the mark is set.
